summary: Humboldt-county lookout on Brannan Mountain, active 1922-1932 in newspapers; listed as gone, and a trip report describes a radio reflector on the summit.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; an undated trip report describes a radio reflector on the summit, not a lookout.

visit.trail_note: A rough, ungated road climbs to the summit from Brannan Mtn Rd, per a hiker's trip report; the report does not say whether the land is open to the public.

notes_for_editor: History is newspaper-only (1922-1932, via the Kemnow page). No build date, design, staffing after 1932, or removal date in any source. The record's agency Trinity National Forest is the 1920s-30s name; the current manager is not verified. A search snippet suggested Brannan Mountain may lie near the Six Rivers National Forest boundary; that was not confirmed and is not used. The trip report (Bob Burd, undated on the page) describes the summit radio reflector and mentions no lookout; its date should be checked before anyone relies on the 'today' description. Kind 'unknown' stays as in the record. Visit.drive_up rests on a trip report, and access rights are not stated.
